rows.grounds: vocative address; compound describing the face as like a lotus
vocative epithet; compound expressing great fortune or eminence
vocative name or epithet addressing Tripuṣkara

items.question: Who is being reverently saluted through the epithets lotus-faced and greatly fortunate Tripuṣkara?
premises: The vocative particle he marks a direct address.
The epithets kamala+āsya and mahā+bhāga qualify the addressee.
The word namas expresses obeisance directed to te.
The name tri+puṣkara identifies the recipient of the salutation.
items.inference: The speaker offers obeisance to the addressed figure Tripuṣkara, characterized as lotus-faced and greatly fortunate.
uncertainties: The specific identity or role of Tripuṣkara in this context is not explicit within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O lotus-faced, greatly fortunate Tripuṣkara, obeisance to you.
